entries.title: 공원 탁자에서
entries.scene: 민트색 백팩을 메고 공원 탁자에 앉아 책을 읽어요. 연분홍 손잡이와 바닥이 가까이 보여요.
entries.alt: 민트색 No.1084H 백팩을 메고 공원 탁자에 앉아 책을 읽는 사람을 가까이 본 AI 착용 연출

composition.framing: close upper torso and seated hips with full bag and profile face
composition.activity: reading an open book while wearing both backpack straps at picnic table
composition.setting: outdoor park picnic table with softly blurred autumn trees

entries.fidelityReview: Direct source/output comparison: mint body, pale pink paired handle/tabs, lower pink strip and webbing, round tan brand patch, folded front pocket top edge, tan zipper pulls and side pockets retained. Approximate 28.5:39 front ratio and ordinary worn size remain consistent. Hand anatomy and seated pose checked. Output shows a held open book rather than notebook laid on table; public copy/composition describe actual output.

entries.prompt: Portrait 1024x1536 natural editorial LookBook photograph using the EXACT mint Himawari No.1084H backpack in reference, external 28.5cm wide x39cm high x12cm deep. Fictional East Asian man around 50 seated sideways at an outdoor park picnic table, wearing plain light beige overshirt, reading an open small notebook on the table. Elevated camera over his left shoulder at side-rear three-quarter, CLOSE waist-up including his side face, hands, table edge and entire backpack on his back, no full body. Bag about 50% of frame height, main front panel faces the camera obliquely, both original mint shoulder straps worn naturally. Preserve sage-mint rectangular rounded body, dusty pale pink top grab handle and handle tabs, pink bottom strip and lower webbing, round tan Himawari logo with exact reference lettering, flap-like folded top edge on single large front pocket, tan double zipper pulls, slim mint side pockets. No extra mesh, no new pockets, buckles, chest belt or accessories. Soft overcast daylight, shallow depth background of autumn park trees. Natural anatomy and proportions; bag shape and carry are ordinary, no performance claim.

entries.title: 옷을 받으러 왔어요
entries.scene: 세탁소 앞에서 옷을 받아 들었어요. 다른 손에는 앞주머니 두 개가 보이는 회색 백팩을 들어요.
entries.alt: 세탁소 앞에서 포장된 옷과 회색 No.1230 백팩을 각각 손에 든 사람의 전신 AI 착용 연출

composition.framing: full-body with both shoes and neighbourhood storefront
composition.activity: holding original single black grab loop and a covered garment on hanger
composition.setting: daylit entrance of unbranded neighbourhood dry-cleaning shop

entries.fidelityReview: Direct source/output comparison: grey rounded body, original single black top loop, curved black upper zip, separate long front pockets with rounded black mesh flaps and horizontal zips, dangling black pulls, low triangular black badge on right pocket and grey side pockets retained. Shoulder straps hang behind, no invented handle/strap or opening. Plausible 32x40x18 bag relative to full adult body. Both hands, hanger grip, legs and shoes checked.

entries.prompt: Portrait 1024x1536 environmental editorial LookBook photograph. Exact grey Himawari No.1230 backpack from reference, 32cm wide x40cm high x18cm deep. Fictional South Asian woman around 35 with short wavy dark hair, plain rust red coat, dark blue trousers and flat shoes, standing outside a small unbranded neighbourhood dry-cleaning shop. Front three-quarter eye-level FULL BODY view with both shoes and storefront in frame, NOT rear view, stationary. With one hand she holds the bag's ORIGINAL SINGLE BLACK TOP GRAB LOOP naturally beside her thigh, the entire grey bag front toward camera, bag about25% of image height. Her other hand holds a plain garment in transparent cover on hanger just received, no other person necessary. Exact rounded grey upper shape with curved black main zip, two separate long grey front pockets each topped by rounded BLACK MESH FLAP and horizontal BLACK ZIP above mesh, their black long pull cords hanging in original places, black triangular Himawari logo low on image-right pocket, grey side pocket edges. Original black shoulder straps hang BEHIND bag; no new hand straps, no added accessories. Soft daylight, realistic hand grip and actual human/bag relative scale. Preserve legible logo lettering faithfully, no shop text or promotional graphics.
